name: CompleteDNS nameserver history pages
tier_rationale: Small company with an identifiable operator, public pages and a paid API; P026 cond 5: 'community - CompleteDNS'.

reliability.justification: NS change history pages for manual review; V3LUM takes no verdict from them.

pivot_pages.title: CompleteDNS NS history page /dns-history/?domain={domain} (manual pivot link)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

pivot_pages.notes: Quote: binding council text (cond 1 of the proposal). Research C0057 (verified 2026-11-26, 200). The page pre-fills the domain and loads results through /dns-history/ajax/, which is never linked or called (undocumented endpoint, a paid API exists; P026 cond 8). Used by pivots_domain_dns (pack domain_dns.json).

notes: Manual pivot links only (batch p2-G14-1): V3LUM never fetches them (P311).
